press.t: Utah reaches $183.5 million multistate settlement with Acima
press.d: Settlement provides $431,148.55 in restitution and $1,085,926.26 in lease forgiveness for Utah consumers. The post Utah reaches $183.5 million multistate settlement with Acima appeared first on Utah Attorney General .

press.t: Utah joins FTC in suing Toast over alleged deceptive pricing and hidden fees
press.d: Utah has joined the Federal Trade Commission, six other states, and two local governments in suing Toast, Inc., alleging the company misled restaurant owners with deceptive pricing, false customer support claims, and hidden fees. The post Utah joins FTC in suing Toast over alleged deceptive pricing and hidden fees appeared first on Utah Attorney General .

press.t: Utah and other states reach $220 million settlement with GM over driver data
press.d: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown, the Utah Department of Commerce’s Division of Consumer Protection, and 35 other attorneys general reached a $220 million settlement with General Motors (GM) over allegations that the automaker sold drivers’ driving behavior and location data without their consent. Utah will receive $6,938,619 from the settlement. The post Utah and other states reach $220 million settlement with GM over driver data appeared first on Utah Attorney General .

press.t: Utah settlement cancels $16,758,262 in Snap Finance lease payments
press.d: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown and the Utah Department of Commerce’s Division of Consumer Protection join 16 other states in a $665 million settlement with Snap Finance. oped.t: The Declaration of Independence remains America’s measuring stick for every generation
oped.d: The Declaration of Independence was far more than America’s explanation for separating from Great Britain. It was America’s statement of first principles.

oped.t: Conservation and constitutional limits are not opposing values. Utah proves we can defend both.

oped.t: Religious freedom is critical to the American experiment
oped.d: Together, we can forge a future where faith, freedom, and hope all burn unquenchably—an enduring testament to the resilience of the human spirit. This is our moment to rise—to stand as guardians of a divine trust that transcends time.
